subject: Rahul Gandhi

rows.Finding / value: Rahul Gandhi (राहुल गांधी); Indian National Congress politician; born 19 June 1970; living.
MP for Rae Bareli, Uttar Pradesh, in his fifth Lok Sabha term; Leader of Opposition, Lok Sabha, effective 9 June 2024.
Amethi (2004–2019), Wayanad (2019–2024, with a 2023 disqualification interruption), then Rae Bareli. Won Wayanad again in 2024 and relinquished it effective 18 June.
AICC general secretary from September 2007; Congress vice-president from January 2013; president from 16 December 2017. Resigned after the 2019 defeat; confirmed departure publicly on 3 July.
Rollins graduate (1994), Cambridge MPhil in Development Studies (1995). Family political prominence aided access; assassinations and security concerns also shaped his early life.
Seven constituency contests across five general elections: six wins and one loss. The loss was Amethi in 2019; two wins in 2024 count as one parliamentary term.
He moved from youth-organisation reform and party succession to national opposition campaigning, two cross-country yatras, and formal parliamentary opposition leadership.

His clearest documented contributions are organisational experimentation, sustained opposition advocacy and public mobilisation. The caste-enumeration debate illustrates agenda influence with disputed credit.
Caste representation, redistribution, employment, farmers’ protections, women’s representation and constitutional pluralism recur in his speeches and Congress’s platform.
The 2012 UP setback, 2019 national defeat and Amethi loss, and the 2025 Bihar setback show that campaign visibility has not consistently produced electoral recovery.

The 2023 defamation conviction was stayed, not overturned by the inspected order. In the National Herald money-laundering matter, ED’s challenge to refusal of cognisance remained before the High Court in September 2026.
rows.Research note: Defamation appeal merits after the 2023 stay remain an open retrieval gap. National Herald latest inspected hearing report: 22 September 2026.

rows.Finding / value: Dynastic access and security are evidenced; a specifically gender-based barrier to his advancement is not established. Commentary about physical endurance supplies a bounded example of masculine campaign imagery.

A major test case for Congress’s adaptation to BJP-centred competition. The 2024 recovery enlarged opposition space; it did not itself end BJP centrality or settle Congress’s organisational weaknesses.
